newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia ACF shares debut at 3.90 rgt.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia ACF shares debut at 3.90 rgt.

text.p: Shares of financial services group ACF Holdings Bhd made their market debut at 3.90 ringgit against an offer price of 2.90.
The company offered 11.0 million new shares and 35.24 million vendor shares for its listing on the main board of the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange.
Around five minutes into the opening, the stock was at 4.0 ringgit on volume of 923,000 shares traded. It has traded between 3.80 and 4.10 range.
ACF estimated net earnings of 17.54 million ringgit for the year ended December 31, 1996, and net earnings-per-share of 19.90 cents.
At 3.90 ringgit, price-to-earnings ratio is 19.6 times.
